messages.subject: Pinnacle House, Leeds (title WYK482216) - consent to letting
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Priya,

We act for Halgarth Estates Limited, your borrower in respect of Pinnacle House, Leeds (charge dated 14 March 2019). Halgarth proposes to grant a 15-year lease of Floors 4-5 to Brookmere Software Limited at £612,500 pa with a six-month rent-free... (nine-month rent free) on arm's-length commercial terms. We should be grateful for the Bank's consent to the letting. Heads of terms and draft lease available on request.

Kind regards
Elena Marchetti

Elena,
